title: rupicapnos numidica subsp. praetermissa
intro: Rupicapnos numidica subsp. praetermissa, commonly known as the "Prickly Poppy" or "African Poppy", is a plant species belonging to the family Papaveraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rupicapnos numidica subsp. praetermissa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
